title: 'Children's future won't be compromised': PM Modi hails anti-paper leak Bill in new video
content: Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced Parliament passed a new bill to prevent unfair means in public examinations. This legislation aims to build a more trustworthy examination system across the nation. The government has taken continuous steps to improve examination processes and address paper leaks. This new law will ensure no paper leak mafia or gang playing with students' futures is spared.

title: US signs $58.6bn mega deal for Patriot missiles as stock runs low amid Iran war
content: The United States awarded Lockheed Martin a significant contract for Patriot interceptor missiles. This deal ensures long-term production of crucial air defence interceptors for the US Army.  Concerns over dwindling missile stockpiles influenced this major procurement decision.  The agreement aims to triple production capacity and boost employment at a key facility.  This expansion supports broader Pentagon efforts to accelerate weapons manufacturing globally.

title: Future India captain? Selector explains why Sooryavanshi was named East Zone vice-captain
content: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, aged fifteen, has been appointed East Zone vice-captain for the upcoming Duleep Trophy.  Selectors believe this move invests in the future of Indian cricket and accelerates his development.  Ishan Kishan will captain the team, easing immediate leadership pressure on the young player.  Sooryavanshi's prior leadership roles and strong IPL performance informed this significant selection.

title: CJP protest fallout: Noida woman booked over 'objectionable' remarks against PM Modi
content: Noida Police registered a zero FIR against a 25-year-old woman for alleged objectionable language. The complaint was filed by Supreme Court advocate Smriti Singh after receiving several videos. The accused, Ruchika Singh, was identified and details were gathered by the complainant. Police registered the case under relevant sections of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita. The investigation has been transferred to Delhi Police for further proceedings.

title: NYC banned Motoclick, now Mamdani targets Uber Eats, DoorDash over "hidden" tip buttons
content: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani says the city's crackdown on Uber Eats and DoorDash tipping practices has delivered $104 million in extra tips to delivery workers since January. A new DCWP report shows tips per delivery doubled from $1.18 to $2.29 after apps were forced to show tip buttons at checkout. Mamdani, who earlier moved to shut down Motoclick, warns more enforcement is coming.

title: ‘Unlucky’ taunts, dowry demands: Dehradun teacher dies, husband, in-laws booked
content: A young teacher died by suicide following alleged dowry harassment by her husband and in-laws.  The victim faced months of physical and mental abuse after her marriage last November.  Her family filed a police complaint accusing her husband and his relatives of cruelty.  Authorities registered a dowry death case against the accused individuals and family members.  An investigation is currently underway following the tragic incident in Dehradun.

title: Kevin O'Leary says China's rise will unite US, Canada and Mexico
content: Kevin O'Leary suggests China's growing power will unite North American economies.  Canada offers minerals and energy, while the US provides scale and innovation.  Mexico also plays a vital role in the regional economic landscape.  Companies are increasingly using cheaper Chinese artificial intelligence models.  This shift occurs as the race for technological dominance accelerates globally.

title: Tourist feeding overwhelms Japan’s Rabbit Island as boars attack
content: The unchecked practice of tourists feeding rabbits on Okunoshima has led to an overwhelming rise in their population, creating serious ecological concerns. This steady food source is altering animal behaviors, with wild boars starting to hunt rabbits more frequently. The plant life suffers, evident in the stark 'rabbit line' marking the landscape. Experts suggest implementing regulated feeding practices and formulating long-term conservation strategies for the island.

title: China spent $13.8bn restoring wetlands now valued at $434bn
content: China's coastal wetland restoration projects between 2000 and 2020 showed substantial economic gains. Investments of up to $13.8 billion generated ecosystem benefits valued as high as $434 billion. Mangrove restoration projects, in particular, offered exceptional benefit-cost ratios of 47 to 1. These restored wetlands provide vital carbon storage and coastal protection services. The research highlights restoration as a valuable nature-based solution for climate action.

title: Pennsylvania town calls data centre developer's lawsuit an 'approval by tantrum' bid
content: Plymouth Township is defending its stringent conditions for a proposed AI data centre. Developer Brian O'Neill has legally challenged these requirements, calling them overly burdensome. The township insists it can enforce zoning rules and protect residents' health and safety. O'Neill claims he agreed to most conditions and disputes the township's accusations. A zoning hearing is scheduled for August 6 to present evidence and testimony.

title: Joint property ownership: What happens when co-owners disagree over rent or sale
content: A growing number of buyers are opting for shared homeownership to alleviate financial strain and share loan obligations. In various states, including a woman as a co-owner can unlock potential stamp duty reductions. However, this arrangement necessitates mutual consent for the sale of the property and any loan matters, with each co-owner entitled to sell their respective portion. Disputes between co-owners can result in negotiations, buyouts, or legal partitions.

title: Odisha med PG exam question paper ‘shared on WhatsApp’ mid-test; dean denies 'paper leak'
content: An Odisha medical postgraduate examination question paper was allegedly shared on social media. This incident occurred on July 27 during the All Odisha Medical PG Examination. Images of the General Surgery second paper were reportedly circulated in WhatsApp groups. An internal investigation is now underway to determine how this happened. Authorities are tightening security for the remaining examinations.

title: 'A date for history books': India to face Brazil in historic football match in Kolkata
content: The All India Football Federation (AIFF) confirmed the fixture on Wednesday after reports in Brazilian media over the past few days.

title: Fortnite John Wick Sprite: Location, abilities, and how to unlock it
content: Fortnite's new v41.30 update brings the John Wick Sprite exclusively to Reload mode. Players can find this Sprite in normal and special Sprite chests within the game. Eliminating opponents who possess the Sprite also allows for its acquisition by other players. Winning a Victory Royale in Reload mode guarantees the John Wick Sprite for all participants. This Sprite reveals nearby enemies for a short duration after an elimination.

title: Patriots, Chargers linked to $62M Buccaneers DT amid trade rumors
content: Vita Vea requested a trade from the Tampa Bay Buccaneers after contract extension talks failed. New England Patriots and Los Angeles Chargers are top candidates for the 31-year-old defensive tackle at the moment. With the Patriots, he could form a Super Bowl-rich defensive front. With the Chargers, he could be a better disruptor than the current one.

title: Why Lamine Yamal says he can never repay his mother's sacrifices
content: Lamine Yamal, the 19-year-old World Cup winner, has spoken openly about a childhood shaped by financial hardship and parental sacrifice. His mother, Sheila Ebana, emigrated from Equatorial Guinea to Spain as a teenager, had Yamal at 16, and raised him largely alone after separating from his father when Lamine was three. Yamal credits her with shielding him from the worst of their circumstances, saying she made him see only the beautiful side of life. He also reflected on his rapid rise at Barcelona, describing himself as a creative and entertaining player who never anticipated reaching the first team quite so quickly

title: E20 petrol debate: Govt debunks 7 claims - impact on mileage, engines & more
content: Road Transport and Highways Minister Nitin Gadkari has said that petrol blended with 20% ethanol (E20) may lower fuel efficiency by 2-6%, depending on the type and age of the vehicle.

title: 'Step taken under BJP pressure': Naveen Patnaik hits out at hockey's saffron jersey
content: The Indian men's and women's hockey teams will wear saffron jerseys instead of their traditional blue kits at next month's FIH World Cup in the Netherlands and Belgium.

title: 'How is unelected minister continuing for over six months?' SC raps Bihar govt
content: The Supreme Court questioned the Bihar government regarding a minister's continued service.  This minister has served beyond the six-month constitutional limit without legislative election.  The court seeks an explanation for this continuation under Article 164(4) of the Constitution.  A petition challenges the minister's reappointment after a government change.  The court referenced a prior judgment on similar constitutional provisions.

title: NEET-UG 2026 case: CBI links leak to teachers who set paper, did translation work
content: In a shocking revelation, subject experts are accused of memorizing and leaking NEET-UG 2026 exam questions after receiving daily access from home. These reconstructed queries found their way into private coaching classes, with a beautician reportedly formatting them for sale. The scheme's spread across multiple states is now under scrutiny, leading the CBI to file a chargesheet against thirteen individuals implicated in this alleged scam.

title: Big relief for CJP protesters: Delhi govt drops cases, but there's a key condition
content: In a significant decision, the Delhi government will not take further legal steps against the majority of protesters from the July 20 'Chalo Sansad' march. This brings a sense of relief to many who were involved. Authorities are moving swiftly to review and potentially release detained individuals, though exceptions apply for those with prior criminal records, with police noting over 2,800 such individuals connected to the protests.

title: Former captains slam saffron hockey jersey: 'India's identity has always been blue'
content: ​​"Everything in the country is being saffronised," said former India captain Pargat Singh while criticizing Hockey India's decision.

title: Mumbai's Rs 10 crore-plus home market scales a record Rs 18,512 crore in H1 2026
content: Mumbai's luxury housing market recorded its highest half-yearly transaction value in 2026. Buyers spent Rs 18,512 crore on homes priced at Rs 10 crore and above. This segment saw a 12% growth over the previous year's performance. Established areas like Worli led sales, registering a significant increase in value. Demand remains strong, particularly for homes in the Rs 20-40 crore range.

title: The 'fire-breathing dragon of clouds' over France: When a wildfire creates its own weather
content: France has recorded its first known 'fire cloud' as extreme wildfires sweep across Europe. Also called a pyrocumulonimbus, the towering storm forms when intense heat pushes smoke, air and moisture high into the atmosphere. It can generate powerful winds, lightning and fresh fires, allowing a wildfire to influence, and sometimes create, its own weather.

title: Govt summons Meta again over temporary restriction of PM Modi's FB post
content: India's government has summoned Meta executives to explain a temporary restriction on Prime Minister Modi's video. The social media giant acknowledged the error and has restored the content. New protocols are being introduced for prominent public figures' accounts. This incident highlights ongoing scrutiny of content moderation by tech firms. The government seeks explanations for platform governance and content handling.

title: Watch: UP cop snatches Kangana Ranaut effigy, runs as Congress workers chase
content: During a recent Congress protest highlighting concerns about remarks made by Kangana Ranaut regarding women, a police inspector intervened dramatically. He swiftly seized an effigy of the actress to prevent it from being set on fire by agitated protesters. The incident, centered around allegations of disrespect toward young women, has sparked a flurry of discussions online, with videos of the event going viral.

title: 'Composure isn't the opposite of aggression': Sachin's heartfelt tribute to Rahane
content: Ajinkya Rahane announced his retirement from international cricket on Thursday.  Sachin Tendulkar led tributes, recalling Rahane's dedication and leadership qualities.  Former coach Ravi Shastri praised his yeoman service to Indian cricket.  Cheteshwar Pujara and Virender Sehwag also celebrated his career achievements.  Rahane retires with 5,077 Test runs and an unbeaten captaincy record.

title: Chennai court sentences Chhota Rajan to seven years' imprisonment in fake passport case
content: The CBI court convicted Rajan under charges of cheating, forgery, cheating by personation and knowingly submitting forged documents to obtain a passport.

title: EPA expands electricity bill pledge signed by Google, Meta and Amazon
content: Tech giants pledge to cover energy costs for their facilities.  The Environmental Protection Agency expanded this pledge to include utilities and regulators.  New guidance exempts data centers not connected to the public grid from certain regulations.  This move aims to support artificial intelligence infrastructure development.  It also seeks to prevent higher electricity bills for American households.

title: From ayurveda to finance: Patanjali gets IRDAI nod for Rs 4.5Kcr insurance entry
content: Patanjali Ayurved is set to enter financial services after IRDAI approved its nearly Rs 4,500 crore acquisition of Magma General Insurance.

title: UP horror: Landlord 'rapes' tenant's minor daughter repeatedly, records videos
content: Police reported a 10-year-old girl was allegedly raped by her landlord in Goverdhan. The accused, a 42-year-old West Bengal native, had assaulted the minor previously. The victim informed her mother after the incident on Wednesday. Police registered a case under BNS and POCSO sections. The girl has undergone medical examination and further legal action is pending.

title: Fleming takes over as England Test coach; ex-CSK boss begins new era with Root
content: Stephen Fleming has been appointed as England men's Test head coach. He replaces Brendon McCullum and will begin his tenure later this summer. Marcus Trescothick will serve as interim coach for the Pakistan series. Fleming expressed excitement about working with returning captain Joe Root. The new partnership aims to rebuild England's red-ball cricket fortunes.

title: E20 petrol can reduce vehicle mileage by up to 6%: Nitin Gadkari in Parliament
content: E20 petrol may reduce vehicle mileage by two to six percent. Extensive testing has found no engine failures linked to this fuel. Studies indicate improved acceleration and better ride quality with E20. Carbon emissions are reduced by approximately thirty percent compared to E10. Automobile manufacturers continue to honor warranty claims for vehicles using E20.

title: Kirti Kulhari loses Rs 2.4 lakh to cyber fraud; files complaint
content: In a shocking turn of events, Kirti Kulhari, the talented actress, encountered cyber fraud in Mumbai. Unidentified criminals infiltrated her mobile phone and credit card, executing unauthorized transactions that totaled Rs 243,852 in mere minutes. Disturbed by this breach, Kulhari promptly reported the incident to the police, prompting the Cyber Cell to launch an investigation. The incident happened while she enjoyed a show at a theatre in Andheri West.

title: Denied seat, student hacks IIT-Kanpur website to show his 'merit'

The IIT director invited the candidate to campus for an assessment. He stressed that hacking was not the correct approach to gain entry. The institute will consider him if genuine talent is demonstrated.

title: Who was Billy Ray Smith Jr? Chargers legend dies at 64 after remarkable career
content: Billy Ray Smith Jr., the former San Diego Chargers linebacker and College Football Hall of Famer, died at 64 after struggling with dementia caused by CTE. Here's everything to know about his life, from his childhood in Arkansas and standout college career to his decade in the NFL, his broadcasting journey, his wife, Kimberly Hunt, his family, and his lasting football legacy. The Chargers legend spent his entire professional career with the franchise and remained a respected voice in sports long after retirement.
